_schema.description: Engines shown on the dashboards: the QVAC engine, the competitors of the campaign in comparisons.json and the engines of the comparison report imported by import-report.py. measured_on is filled by build-dashboard-data.py from the rows; details and source are the campaign's or the report's own words.

fields.engine: Engine name exactly as comparisons.json or report-rows.json spells it.
fields.role: QVAC engine, prior-report competitor or new competitor, measured.
fields.ggml: ggml-based or not, as a short phrase.
fields.details: Scope and caveats of the engine's rows.
fields.not_measured: Optional list of {host, backend, task, model, reason}: models of the weekly matrix this engine cannot measure on that host; build-dashboard-data.py turns them into coverage cells of the host (status not attempted).

rows.details: Weekly rows from the Sunday run of the engine master and ggml speech heads on every shared machine; campaign rows from the dated comparison at the build the campaign measured.
handy-computer/transcribe.cpp on Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 Q8_0, the same 11.0 s and 98.49 s clips as QVAC.
rows.source: QVAC speech engines report (Gustavo Araujo, 2026-10-01 edition)

rows.details: senstella/parakeet-mlx on the mlx-community Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 conversion (bf16), Metal GPU through MLX, driven by the weekly run on the Mac Studio with the model loaded once and the clip's log-mel, encoder and decoder timed in process, the same scope as the QVAC native rows.
rows.source: scripts/benchmarks/desktop-weekly (families parakeet-mlx and parakeet-mlx-abcba through mlx-bench.py)

rows.details: ml-explore mlx-whisper on the mlx-community Whisper small conversion (f16), Metal GPU through MLX, driven by the weekly run on the Mac Studio with the model loaded once and greedy English decoding timed in process; the QVAC whisper-small rows are fresh-process timings, so the two stay in separate charts.
rows.source: scripts/benchmarks/desktop-weekly (families mlx-whisper and mlx-whisper-abcba through mlx-bench.py)

rows.details: Blaizzy/mlx-audio 0.6.4 on the mlx-community conversions (and the original MOSS-TTS v1.5 checkpoint), Metal GPU through MLX, driven by the weekly run on the Mac Studio: Nemotron 3.5 ASR Streaming 0.6B (bf16) decoded offline with the model loaded once, the same scope as the QVAC native rows; Chatterbox Turbo (f16, built-in voice), Audio8 TTS Preview 0.6B (bf16, synthesis and JFK cloning) and MOSS-TTS v1.5 (bf16) as fresh processes including model load like the matching QVAC rows; MiniMax Music3 (8-bit conversion) rendering the 30 s instrumental request of the ACE-Step rows beside the QVAC minimax-music3-q8_0 row.
rows.source: scripts/benchmarks/desktop-weekly (the mlx-audio families of families.json through mlx-bench.py)

not_measured.reason: no MLX path: mlx-community/supertonic-3-mlx is an ONNX Runtime package, not an mlx-audio model
mlx-community/Fun-CosyVoice3-0.5B-2512 is converted for the mlx-audio-plus fork; mlx-audio 0.6.4 has no CosyVoice3 loader
mlx-community/parler-tts-mini exists but mlx-audio 0.6.4 has no parler loader
no MLX conversion and no mlx-audio loader
mlx-community/chatterbox-multilingual-v3 exists; its support in the mlx-audio chatterbox loader is not verified, so it stays out until checked
the only MLX conversion (littlebearlabs/parakeet-unified-en-0.6b-mlx) ships no config.json, so neither parakeet-mlx nor mlx-audio loads it; FluidAudio covers this model on the ANE instead
no MLX conversion (only ONNX and Core ML ones)
no MLX port of ACE-Step (only its 5 Hz language-model half exists as an MLX conversion)

rows.details: FluidInference/FluidAudio (Swift) on its own Core ML conversions with the encoder on the Apple Neural Engine (int8 encoder, decoder and joint on the ANE as well), driven by the weekly run on the Mac Studio through the bench package of scripts/benchmarks/desktop-weekly/fluidaudio-bench: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 and Parakeet Unified English 0.6B, model loaded once and each clip timed in process, the same scope as the QVAC native rows. The rows sit in the Metal lane of the run (the only GPU lane of the machine) and say Core ML, ANE in their variant; QVAC's own Core ML sidecars are a separate topic.

not_measured.reason: FluidAudio runs Nemotron only through its cache-aware streaming manager (chunked, 560 to 2240 ms tiers), not as the offline decode of the QVAC rows; a streaming-policy row is a follow-up
FluidAudio has the Core ML conversion but exposes it only through its streaming end-of-utterance manager; an offline bench of it is a follow-up
FluidAudio ships no Whisper (WhisperKit is the Core ML Whisper engine)
FluidAudio's TTS engines are Kokoro and Lux, none of the models of the weekly matrix
